summary: AUDIT ONLY, no app code changed. I checked all 23 items in the merchant More menu with backend pytest (49 checks across 3 files) and mobile UI Playwright at 390x844 (merchant, marketer and cashier sessions). All 23 screens open with no JS errors, and all 29 section GET APIs return 200. CRUD works on the backend for competitions, roles, branches, services, employees, marketing ads, shipping rules and banners. However: (1) Anyone can run a competition draw without logging in, and the customer competition page shows a 'Start draw' button to every user. (2) Invoices have NO ZATCA Phase 1 or Phase 2 compliance. (3) POS and online orders never reduce stock (branch_inventory is empty and the decrement function silently does nothing). (4) Permissions are hardly checked on the backend (require_employee_perm is used only 2 times), so a cashier can create roles and a marketer can see financial stats and returns. (5) The marketer/affiliate data model does not match the seed data (UI shows 0% / 0 clicks while the DB has 10% / 1245 clicks), checkout never sends referral_code, there is no click tracking in the frontend and there are no payout endpoints. (6) JWT_SECRET is missing from .env, so every backend restart logs everyone out. Deprecated packages: none found (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

POS (/merchant/pos).works: Loads 40 products and 3 branches. Add to cart, then checkout, then issue invoice works end-to-end in the UI (invoice INV-000031 was created, then cleaned up).
bugs: No stock is reduced: decrement_channel_stock returns early when there is no branch_inventory doc, and the collection has 0 docs. product.stock is never touched (server.py:2660)
Backend trusts the price, VAT % and product_id sent by the client: an invoice with price -50, a fake product and VAT 0 was accepted (total -50)
Discount is subtracted AFTER VAT (total = subtotal + vat - discount, server.py:4114), so VAT is charged on the pre-discount amount
Invoice number = count_documents({})+1. It is global (not per merchant) and gets reused after a delete (INV-000031 was issued twice)
No stock check, no barcode scanner, product images not shown on the POS cards
After issuing there is no receipt, print or QR screen (cart just clears). send_via='whatsapp' is stored but nothing is sent
The marketer employee sees 'no products' on POS while the merchant sees 40, so product scoping is inconsistent

Invoices (/merchant/invoices).works: Lists /api/pos/invoices with today's totals. WhatsApp share sends a wa.me text link only.
bugs: The 30 seeded invoices have merchant_id=None, so they never appear (the screen shows 0)
There is no invoice detail, print or PDF screen. The only buttons are WhatsApp text and 'Open POS' (which leaves the section)
Only POS invoices are listed. Online orders never create an invoices document
The customer /invoices page is built on the fly from orders (INV-<last 8 of order id>): no sequence number, no QR, no print

zatca_compliance.seller_name: only employee_name; no seller legal name stored
zatca_compliance.vat_registration_15_digits: MISSING (no field on the merchant user or settings)
zatca_compliance.buyer_info: name and phone only (optional); no buyer VAT number or address for a standard B2B invoice
zatca_compliance.vat_per_line: MISSING (VAT only at total level; discount applied after VAT)
zatca_compliance.tlv_base64_qr_5_tags: MISSING (no qr anywhere in the backend or frontend)
zatca_compliance.credit_debit_notes: MISSING (returns/RMA refunds create no credit note; no credit_notes collection)
zatca_compliance.verdict: NOT compliant with ZATCA Phase 1 or Phase 2

bugs: Shows 0 for every metric ('no items') because branch_inventory has 0 docs, while products carry their own stock field (e.g. 47/58). There are two stock sources and neither is updated by sales
GET /merchant/inventory and /merchant/branches query find({}) with no merchant_id filter (no tenant isolation)
missing: Serial/IMEI tracking (important for a phone store)

Marketing & Ads (/merchant/marketing).works: Ad create/list/delete works on the backend (no PUT/edit endpoint). Tabs: ads (0) / marketers (5).
missing: Ad performance analytics beyond the track counter

Marketers & Commissions (/merchant/marke.stays_inside: partial: tapping a marketer opens a separate /merchant/marketer-stats screen
bugs: Schema mismatch: the seed stores commission_rate/clicks/conversions/sales_total/commission_earned, but the backend/UI read commission_percent/total_conversions/total_sales/total_earnings. The UI shows 0% / 0 clicks / 0 SAR, while NAWAF25 actually has 10%, 1245 clicks and 3458 SAR
Commission on orders uses commission_percent with a default of 5 (server.py:949), so the merchant's 10% rate is ignored

checkout.tsx never sends referral_code and nothing in the frontend calls /affiliate/{code}/click or captures a deep link, so attribution and click tracking never happen from the UI (affiliate_conversions = 0)
POST /affiliate/{code}/click is unauthenticated with no dedupe (click fraud)
No payout/transfer endpoints (GET /merchant/affiliate/payouts returns 404). commission_paid/pending exist only in seed data
0 affiliate_applications, so the approve/reject flow can't be checked in the UI
Marketers & Commissions (/merchant/marke.marketer_role: Login 0530000002 is an EMPLOYEE (perms social/competitions/banners), not an affiliate. It lands on the full /merchant dashboard (sees total sales 1,336,246 SAR and the whole More menu, including POS/Invoices/Employees). /api/affiliate/dashboard and /affiliate/my return 403 (customer-only), and /my-affiliate shows 'no active marketer account'. Employee marketer and affiliate marketer are confused with each other.

Social (/merchant/social).notes: 56 posts and the comments tab load. GET /merchant/social/comments returns comments for ALL merchants (find({})).

Competitions (/merchant/competitions).works: Create works through competition-form (types general/qa/purchase/ugc_video; backend also allows signup). Backend PUT and DELETE work.
bugs: CRITICAL: POST /api/competitions/{id}/draw has NO auth (server.py:351). It picks winners, sets status=ended and overwrites winners
CRITICAL: the customer screen app/competition/[id].tsx:147 shows a 'Start draw' button (testID draw-btn) to any user while the competition is open, and it calls the unauthenticated draw
GET /competitions/{id}/participants is public and leaks every participant's phone number
The merchant list has only delete and create: cards can't be tapped, there is no edit, draw, winners or analytics link (competition-analytics is only reachable from live-preview)
PUT/DELETE have no merchant_id scope and no 'competitions' permission check
All 10 seeded competitions are type 'general' (labels like 'Invite a friend', 'UGC', 'Questions' don't match the type), and joined_count (e.g. 2456) doesn't match the real entries (431 total)
The 'Claim gift' button on the customer winners list has no onPress (dead)
The screen uses a light/white theme, different from the dark app theme
missing: Entry rules UI beyond spend/max submissions

bugs: The merchant screen reads the public /api/banners (published only, cached 90s), so unpublished banners disappear from the merchant's own list
No edit; the delete confirm uses a multi-button RN Alert, which does nothing on web
101 cards show an empty customer, an empty device and 'Total 0 SAR'. The seed uses user_name/total_fee but the UI reads customer fields, device_model and total_amount/service_price
Rows show '— · —' for customer/service; same field mismatch. This is a duplicate of service-bookings
Monthly sales = 0 even though there are 321 orders (orders are not linked to branches)
No tenant filter
POST returns the users _id, but list/delete use the drivers doc id. Deleting with the returned id leaves an orphan driver user that can still log in
No merchant 'assign driver to order' endpoint; drivers only self-accept ready_for_pickup orders. 0 of 321 orders have a driver_id
GET /merchant/drivers is find({}) (no tenant filter)

Shipping matrix.notes: Rule CRUD OK; the carriers (SMSA etc.) are config only, no real carrier API (MOCKED).

Returns (/merchant/returns).works: 5 RMAs; decision and inspection flow. A refund credits the wallet plus a wallet_transaction.
bugs: A refund doesn't restock inventory and doesn't create a credit note or link to the invoice
Reverse pickup is only a status record (no carrier call)

Loyalty programs.notes: The Qitaf etc. catalog is informational; it needs partner contracts (MOCKED). There is also a double points award per order: loyalty_transactions plus users.points (server.py:908-994).

bugs: Read-only list (29). Rows can't be tapped: no customer profile, orders, invoices, wallet or notes
Shows '0 orders' for everyone

Employees.notes: Backend CRUD OK. Opened by the marketer employee it shows 0 employees (merchant_id scoping); the backend returns 403 as it should.

bugs: Roles are not enforced: the cashier (perms pos/invoices/orders/customers) could POST /merchant/roles with permissions ['all']
Assigning a role does not update employees_count

Support settings.notes: PUT is gated by the 'settings' permission (one of only 2 permission-checked endpoints).

critical.issue: No authentication: anyone can draw winners and end any competition. The customer UI exposes the button (competition/[id].tsx:147)
Not in backend/.env, so it falls back to a random token_hex every boot (server.py:37). All tokens are invalidated on every restart/deploy
Unauthenticated (no signature): anyone can mark an order paid or change its delivery status
require_merchant lets any employee through; require_employee_perm is used only 2 times. Cashier creating a role returns 200; marketer reading /merchant/stats and /merchant/rmas returns 200
Trusts client price/VAT/product; accepted a -50 SAR invoice; VAT computed before discount; numbering count-based and duplicated
Silent no-op when there is no branch_inventory (0 docs), so stock never decreases for POS or online orders
No VAT number, CR, UUID, hash chain, TLV QR, UBL XML, CSID or credit notes. Online orders produce no invoice
Field-name mismatch (commission_rate vs commission_percent etc.), so stats show 0 and commission uses 5% instead of the configured 10%. No payouts API

minor.issue: branches, drivers, inventory, social comments and competitions PUT/DELETE use find({}) or no merchant_id scope
Returns the users id, but delete expects the drivers id, leaving an orphan driver login
VAT not applied to the delivery fee; no stock validation; loyalty points awarded twice (loyalty_transactions plus users.points)
No brute-force lockout (6 wrong logins, then the correct login still returns 200); CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True; tokens kept in localStorage (no httpOnly cookie)

ui_bugs.issue: 'Start draw' button visible to all users
Cards show empty customer/device and 0 SAR (field mismatch with the data)
Cards can't be tapped; no edit, draw, winners or analytics; light theme differs from the dark app
No detail, print or PDF; seeded invoices hidden (merchant_id null)
Multi-button RN Alert.alert does nothing on react-native-web, so delete is dead in the web preview (fine on native)

integration_issues.issue: checkout.tsx never sends referral_code; no click/deep-link capture
Employees land on the full merchant dashboard (sales totals) and see every More item regardless of permissions (more.tsx has no permission filter)
Invoice is created but no stock moves; no receipt shown
Wallet credited, but no credit note and no restock

issues: Light theme in a dark app
Delete icons are the only action (touch target about 20px)

action_items: Add Depends(get_current_user) plus a merchant/chamber role check to POST /competitions/{id}/draw, and hide draw-btn in competition/[id].tsx for non-merchants; make /participants private or mask phones

Enforce require_employee_perm on every /merchant/* endpoint (roles_manage, customers, orders, inventory, competitions, etc.) and filter more.tsx items and the dashboard KPIs by the employee's permissions
POS: load price from the DB, validate stock and qty>0, apply the discount before VAT, use an atomic per-merchant counter for invoice numbers, show a receipt/print screen
Stock: either seed branch_inventory from product.stock or make decrement_channel_stock fall back to products.stock

ZATCA: add merchant VAT number, CR and address settings; per-line VAT; UUID; ICV; PIH hash chain; TLV base64 QR (tags 1-5); simplified vs standard; credit notes from RMA refunds; UBL 2.1 XML; plan CSID onboarding (Phase 2). Create invoices for online orders too

Affiliates: unify field names (commission_rate vs commission_percent etc.); send referral_code from checkout; capture ?ref deep links and call /affiliate/{code}/click; add payout request/approve/transfer endpoints and UI inside the marketers tab; give the marketer employee or the affiliate a proper dashboard (/affiliate/dashboard currently returns 403 for employees)
Merchant competitions: add edit, draw, winners and analytics inside the screen; seed correct competition_type values; add a referral type; make 'Claim gift' work
Fix field mapping in service-bookings/bookings (user_name, total_fee)
Banners screen should use a merchant endpoint that includes unpublished banners
Drivers: return the drivers doc id from POST; add merchant 'assign driver to order'
Add merchant_id scoping to branches, drivers, inventory, social comments and competitions PUT/DELETE
Remove the double loyalty award in POST /orders; apply VAT to the delivery fee
Add brute-force lockout on login; restrict CORS origins
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6680 lines; split it into routers (pos, invoices, competitions, affiliates, inventory)
Draw logic is duplicated in do_draw and chamber_draw (server.py:351-402)
get_current_user accepts ?token= in the query string, which can leak tokens in logs
The OrderInput referral_code path is dead code from the UI's point of view

success_rate.backend: 61% (30/49 checks passed; all 29 section GETs pass, 7 of 9 CRUD tests pass; most failures are security/compliance checks)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of screens open without JS error; about 9/23 sections fully working, 11 partial, 2 broken (inventory, service-bookings display), 1 stub (loyalty)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_ items created during the audit (competition, role, branch, driver, service, employee, ad, shipping rule, banner, 3 POS invoices including one at -50 SAR) were deleted, including an orphan TEST driver user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Driver login in test_credentials.md is 0540001111/driver1234 (the review request said 0540000001). Do NOT call /api/competitions/{real_id}/draw: it has no auth and will end a live competition. branch_inventory is empty, so inventory tests show 0. Seeded invoices have merchant_id=None. The POS invoice number is count-based: deleting test invoices makes numbers repeat.
rca_of_issue: Draw: the handler at server.py:351 has no Depends(get_current_user), and the customer UI calls it. Stock: decrement_channel_stock returns at line 2662 when there is no branch_inventory doc (the comment promises a fallback that isn't implemented). Affiliates: the seed_demo_marketers.py field names differ from those read in server.py:949-971 and the UI. Permissions: require_merchant accepts the 'employee' role and only 2 endpoints call require_employee_perm.
